defs.def: a person whose job is to take care of people's teeth 牙科医生

ex.s: He recommended that she do some research and talk to dentists about what a healthier candy would contain.
ex.t: 他建议她做些研究，并和牙医谈谈更健康的糖果应包含什么。

ex.s: She also approached dentists to learn more about teeth cleaning.
ex.t: 她还拜访牙医，以了解更多关于洁牙的知识。

ex.s: It is produced to a dentists' recipe.
ex.t: 它是按牙医的配方生产的。

ex.s: Li Ling: I know, but I have always wanted to study medicine and become a dentist.
ex.t: 李玲：我知道，但我一直想学医，成为一名牙医。

ex.s: A dentist once examined me and told me that too much sugar in my meals had damaged my teeth and health.
ex.t: 一位牙医曾检查我，告诉我饮食中过多糖分损害了我的牙齿和健康。

ex.s: In years to come there will of course, still be traditional jobs such as doctors, dentists and 1 lawless / lawyers but also lots of new areas to work in.
ex.t: 未来当然仍会有医生、牙医和律师等传统工作，也会出现许多新领域。

ex.s: C She worked as a dentist.

defs.def: a place where a dentist sees patients 牙科诊所
